amends: results/research/c_subgroups/spec.json, after its run (results.json, job run 570257730256860) and a fresh review; that run's file is kept unchanged
why: PLAN.md's shared rule: every test result also gets a row without the 47 documented MSK patients; the first spec left it out
the detailed plan (docs/research_extension_plan.md) also lists BiomedCLIP zero-shot per group and the in-distribution alert rate per group; the first spec left both out
the first run attached bootstrap intervals for metrics the minimums withhold, and did not check that saved drift scores line up with the images
unchanged: everything in the first spec not listed under changes: attributes, age bands, group keys, minimums, bootstrap, drift definition, models, reproduction gate

populations.client_test: the clients' pooled test split (3,262 images), as in Phase 2 and Phase B
populations.buenos_aires: labelled images, the analysis look's seven-class mapping
populations.pad_ufes: labelled images, the analysis look's seven-class mapping
populations.client_test_without_overlap_patients: the client test split without every image of the 47 patients in config/patient_overlap_v1.csv (as in Phase B)

models.probe_seed0, probe_seed1, probe_seed2: the BiomedCLIP linear probe of results/research/b_vlm/spec.json, regenerated from the same embeddings with the same settings and seeds
models.zero_shot: BiomedCLIP zero-shot with the Phase B spec's template, regenerated and gated like the probe

changes.intervals: only for metrics a group reports (balanced accuracy, and melanoma sensitivity where it has 100 melanomas), with the number of usable resamples
changes.alert_rate: within the client test split, the share of each group's images whose Mahalanobis score is above the 95th percentile of the whole client test split's scores (so 5% overall by construction): EfficientNet per seed (mean and range) and BiomedCLIP; groups under 100 images get counts only. It shows whether a drift alert would fire more often for some in-distribution groups.
changes.alignment_gate: for each EfficientNet seed and each of test, Buenos Aires and PAD-UFES-20, the saved GPU max-softmax scores must match the negative top probability in results/phase2/analysis_look/predictions.csv.gz row for row, mean absolute difference at most 0.02 (aligned rows differ by about 0.006 between GPU and CPU; rows shifted by one differ by about 0.23), or the run stops
changes.provenance: the Delta version of workspace.cdm.silver_images at run time is recorded
